Write a short production plan for GIMP+Blender PBR prop pipeline (Threshold 10.21).

PLAN: GIMP+Blender PBR prop (10.21)
1. Scope: one exterior prop · extend-only · no clearWorld
2. Name contract: Engine name "Mat Stone Crate" → textures/mat_stone_crate_albedo.png · import/mat_stone_crate.glb
3. Mesh: World.createObject cube or blender:export GLB → gltfImport
4. Materials: MaterialPresets.applyMaterialPreset first · then GIMP PBR maps via textures:watch
5. Footsteps: userData.surfaceType = concrete|wood|metal|grass
6. Live: BuildJob multi-step · LiveBuild pause-guard · HUD
7. Perf: Neg LOD ~100m on far static · locked floor
8. Verify: PLAY walk · hot reload albedo · export later
Write a short production plan for live multi-step courtyard with GIMP textures (Threshold 10.21).

PLAN: Live courtyard + GIMP (10.21)
1. Scope: courtyard props near spawn · no clearWorld mid-job
2. Collision: dynamic crates mass ~8 · surfaceType wood
3. Mesh: World.createObject type-first · name slug-match GIMP
4. Materials: MaterialPresets pbr_wood_snow / pbr_brick_aged then TextureBridge maps
5. Live: BuildJob 3 steps · LiveBuild.applyChunk per step · ensureEditable pause
6. Textures: npm run gimp:install · textures:watch · Filters → Threshold → Export PBR Maps
7. LOD: NegativeLod on far props · GraphicsProfile balanced
8. Verify: Live HUD complete · undo last step · no wipe
Write a short production plan for Blender avatar import + wardrobe (Threshold 10.21).

PLAN: Blender avatar + wardrobe (10.21)
1. Scope: one rigged humanoid · no clearWorld
2. Export: blender:avatar --blend file.blend --object Armature → import/<slug>.glb
3. Import: gltfImport / INSERT · match object name
4. Shape: AppearanceProfile / body sliders · soft-scale only
5. Wardrobe: ClothingLayout slots · avatar-mods catalog
6. Footsteps: surfaceType on shoes/floor · footsteps.js
7. Play: PlayAs K possess · PLAY mode
8. Verify: walk cycle · no hop · mobile surface optional

Write a short production plan for player vs creator surface + local minis (Threshold 10.21).

PLAN: Surfaces + local minis (10.21)
1. Scope: phone play vs creator AI chrome · no new auth
2. Player: SurfaceProfile player · hides Ollama probe · ?surface=player
3. Creator/full: SETUP → AGENTS · Small threshold-mini-npc · Medium threshold-mini-dev
